purpose: Pilot token-cap calibration and DeepSeek-R1 temperature selection only; not for official grading or final analysis.
r1_temperature_selection_rule: Manually inspect all 27 DeepSeek-R1 temperature-0 responses across C0, C1, and C2 for visible repetition, looping, or incoherence, and compare them against the corresponding 27 temperature-0.6 responses. If any temperature-0 response exhibits the targeted pathology, select temperature 0.6 for the official experiment; otherwise retain temperature 0 for consistency with the other temperature-controlled models. Do not choose based on token count alone.
token_cap_rule: After choosing the official R1 temperature, use only the token data from DeepSeek V3 temp=0, GPT-4o temp=0, o3-mini medium reasoning, and DeepSeek R1 at the chosen temperature to calibrate the final universal token cap. Do not pool both R1 temperatures into the cap calculation.
